description: This file defines the NormalizerService class in the OrangeHRM project, which provides methods to normalize objects and arrays for a given model class, utilizing a trait for normalization functionalities.

classes.name: NormalizerService
classes.description: A service class providing normalization functionalities for models within the OrangeHRM system, leveraging traits for implementation.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a single object or data of a specified model class into an array format.

methods.name: normalizeArray
methods.description: Normalizes an array of objects or data of a specified model class into an array format.
